lead.headline: 92 political committees each raised $1M+ from individuals in 2024 ($580M total) but passed under 10% to candidates or ads
lead.number: 92 non-joint-fundraising PACs, $580M from individuals, each sending under 10% of spending to candidates, committees, outside ads or affiliates; the 12 busiest treasurers have 29 of 96 such PACs (30%) vs 14.6% for everyone else.
lead.watch_out: No skeptic has checked it; canvassing, digital ads not reported as outside spending, conduits and legal bills all look like a "low share."
